items.title: Identify acidic, basic, and neutral substances using litmus paper
items.explanation: Litmus paper is a natural substance made from lichens that changes color in response to acidity or alkalinity. Blue litmus paper turns red in the presence of acids (like lemon juice, vinegar, tamarind water), while red litmus paper turns blue in the presence of bases (like soap solution, baking soda solution, lime water). Substances that do not change the color are neutral (like tap water, sugar solution, salt solution). This helps classify substances into three groups based on their chemical nature.
